title: Hermes+Alpaca Inverted OBR
author: Roten90
selftext:
4 days in on a live account.

Built this directly from my Hermes/Telegram setup mostly with deepseek V4 PRO and some hard coding task with Claude Fable 5 and did buggtest/code review through Grok externaly, not through Hermes.

Started with a regular ORB setup but got terrible results from the backtest, so terrible I just inverted the whole thing. That means the system still signal breakouts but if its long with good R/R I go short with bad R/R. 

Since its inverted it need good win-rate, backtest said 83%.

It puts a Entry, Stop-loss and Limit-target auto on Alpaca, since its inverted only 1 target.

Only 2 trades at once. Most days I only get 2 trades since I wont reach SL or target before OR-window closes 1,5h after opening.

Probably wont last long but I have had alot of fun so far and learned alot!

Cost of building and running (So far...)

Deepseek Pro V4 - 1,3 billion tokens (29$)

Claude Fable 5 - 3,9 million tokens (22$)

Grok pro plan - (1 year 500$)

Alpaca Pro plan - (99$ per month)
